# `utils/RenderBundleCache.js`

> **Source:** `editor/js/utils/RenderBundleCache.js`

RenderBundleCache - Pre-recorded render commands for static geometry Wraps engine's RenderBundleCache with editor-specific convenience functions. Render bundles record draw calls once and replay them every frame, reducing CPU overhead significantly for static content. Best for: Grid, static meshes, UI elements that don't change

## Functions

### `getOrCreateBundle(device, key, version, descriptor, recordFn)`

Create or get cached render bundle

**Parameters:**

- `device` *(GPUDevice)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `key` *(string)* — Unique identifier for this bundle
- `version` *(number)* — Version number (increment when content changes)
- `descriptor` *(Object)* — Render bundle encoder descriptor
- `recordFn` *(Function)* — Function that records draw calls: (encoder) => void

### `invalidateBundle(key)`

Invalidate a specific bundle (force re-record next frame)

### `invalidateBundlesWithPrefix(prefix)`

Invalidate all bundles matching a prefix

### `clearBundleCache()`

Clear all cached bundles

### `pruneOldBundles(maxAgeMs = 60000)`

Remove bundles not used recently

**Parameters:**

- `maxAgeMs` *(number)* — Maximum age in milliseconds

### `getCacheStats()`

Get cache statistics

### `createStandardDescriptor(colorFormat = 'bgra8unorm', depthFormat = 'depth24plus')`

Helper to create standard descriptor for color + depth rendering

### `executeBundles(passEncoder, bundles)`

Execute render bundles in a render pass

**Parameters:**

- `passEncoder` *(GPURenderPassEncoder)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `bundles` *(GPURenderBundle[])* — _No description in source JSDoc._

## Notes & Examples

### Editor Extension System

The editor supports extensions via the same Plauna component system as apps. Extensions can add panels, tools, menu items, and hooks into the engine. They run with elevated 'editor' capability granting access to the scene graph, asset database, and build pipeline.

**Example: Editor extension adding a custom panel**
```js
import { Extension } from 'editor/core/Extension.js';
import { Panel } from 'editor/ui/Panel.js';

class TerrainEditor extends Extension {
  id = 'terrain-editor';
  capabilities = ['editor', 'scene'];
  
  activate(context) {
    // Add menu item
    context.menus.add('Tools/Terrain', () => this.open());
    
    // Register tool
    context.tools.register('terrain', {
      icon: 'mountain',
      onSelect: (entity) => this.edit(entity)
    });
  }
  
  open() {
    this.panel = new Panel({
      title: 'Terrain Editor',
      content: this.buildUI()
    });
    context.workspace.addPanel(this.panel);
  }
  
  edit(entity) {
    const terrain = entity.get(TerrainComponent);
    this.panel.bind(terrain);
  }
}

editor.extensions.register(TerrainEditor);
```

**See also:** [Editor Overview](/editor/overview.md)
